review_identity: Language-model evidence synthesis plus automated PatAgent checklist; not expert certification or Pat Walters endorsement.
purpose: Scoped software review of non-destructive single-protein-chain extraction and visible missing-atom/residue options before preparation. Confirm atom/whole-molecule identity, original physical frame provenance, retained sequence records, stale preparation/solvation/parameter invalidation, and refusal to cut covalent cross-chain links. A selected coordinate chain is not a verified biological monomer. No MD, prediction, affinity, loop-model quality, or biological assembly claim.

reproducibility.seed_policy: Deterministic selection controls; no stochastic model or MD run planned.
reproducibility.budget: Bundled/synthetic fixtures and existing isolated data only. Zero MD runs, network fetches, predictions, or new parameterization. Small API/unit/browser software controls permitted.

data.policy: Extract a named/indexed protein chain with conservative whole-molecule association, preserve exact retained physical coordinates and sequence identity, retain source unchanged, record included/excluded groups and reasons, reject cross-chain covalent truncation, invalidate source preparation/solvation/parameters on derived subset. Periodic proximity is only an association heuristic, not biological assembly evidence.

validation.status: Read-only design preflight; final implementation evidence pending
validation.scope: Fixture controls for multichain identity, heterogens spanning residues, linked molecules, sequence-retention/chain remapping, unavailable sequence, chosen physical frame, periodic coordinates, atomic output/provenance and source immutability. UI must distinguish observed missing atoms, known missing sequence and unbuildable/unknown gaps.
